planned_only.source_line: Dan was targeting a usable area of about 14 × 24 inches. He planned to use a DeWalt 611 router he already owned and reasoned that a 15 × 25 inch work area might be needed to accommodate it; this is a planning estimate, not a measured finished area. He was considering whether to use a spindle instead. He described intended future work including a wooden electromechanical board game, hardwood cases, keyboard plates, and possible aluminum e-bike parts. These are goals, not reported machine output.
